snippet.title: Peganomics - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3824090/Peganomics/

Peganomics is a roguelike pachinko. Drop balls, hit pegs, and fill buckets to rack up massive scores while chasing the perfect run. Build wild synergies between your balls, pegs, and buckets then watch your combos spiral out of control.

Every run is different: experiment with game-breaking builds, discover unpredictable interactions, and push your score higher and higher.
